purpose: Emphasize that a state has continued throughout a span.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
It has been raining continuously for these past three days.
For the past six months, I have kept a diary every morning.
The phone has been ringing constantly for the past hour.
restrictions: Often with この or ここ to mark a period up to now.
mistake: This is a duration use, distinct from というものだ for a judgment.
